tableLines.line: 👂 Overheard — Thabo (to Márcia): "Leo's story has a fresh coat of paint." Thabo taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Portland, Oregon. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Hayden speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Dmitri.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 A traveler says Emberhold burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, new bindings is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table and Stonebridge have bound together — The Red Table primary. Other fires are climbing, too.
📓 Codex: The Red Table and Stonebridge bound; The Red Table primary.

The little star inside Hayden goes quiet — and wakes up inside Leo. Hayden never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Leo will never be hungry again while it hums, and Hayden is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Deshawn was killed — Yuki did it, they say. (The truth: dead is dead; the killing part is gossip.)
🥣 Tomás of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Tomás waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Thornfield has bound itself to The Red Table. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.

It names your crime first — a full round before the verdict falls." "It names your crime out loud — a real thing you did. The courtroom goes quiet. The naming IS the wound."
